unit_per_step: one decoded token per active sequence
description: Binned median step_ms for vLLM engine.step() during decode, indexed by (BS, total_KV). BS = n_decoding (active sequences). total_KV = sum of (ISL + tokens_generated_so_far) across active sequences, measured BEFORE the step. Per-BS KV axis uses quantile bin edges so each cell has ~equal sample count.
